description: Inventaire canonique complet des donnees utilisees par un desk de trading professionnel. Structure par priorite P0-P21, categorie operationnelle (A-L) et niveau de criticite (1-8).

priority_map.1: Survivre / ne pas casser le desk — positions, cash, margin, risk limits, PnL, orders, fills, kill-switch, restricted list, market status, stale flags
priority_map.2: Executer correctement — bid/ask, depth, spread, volume, venue liquidity, order state, routing, latency, fees, slippage, TCA
priority_map.3: Comprendre le marche maintenant — last price, OHLCV, order flow, volatility, VWAP, auction, OI, funding, basis, breadth, correlation
priority_map.4: Comprendre le risque global — beta, factor exposure, sector/currency/rates exposure, greeks, credit spread, scenario PnL, stress, VaR
priority_map.5: Comprendre le catalyseur — news, filings, earnings, macro releases, central banks, analyst revisions, M&A, regulatory, geopolitical
priority_map.6: Comprendre qui est deja positionne — COT, OI, ETF flows, short interest, borrow, dealer gamma, options positioning, fund flows, liquidations
priority_map.7: Ameliorer le signal — fundamentals, estimates, valuation, technical indicators, model features, backtests, alternative data, research, regime
priority_map.8: Prouver, auditer, apprendre — audit trail, trade logs, decision logs, model version, data lineage, post-trade review, compliance, settlement

category_structure.A: Reference Data — instruments, identifiers, calendars, specs
category_structure.B: Market Data — prices, books, trades, volume, volatility
category_structure.C: Internal State — positions, PnL, capital, limits, orders
category_structure.D: Execution Data — routing, fills, slippage, fees, TCA
category_structure.E: Risk Data — exposures, Greeks, VaR, stress, scenarios
category_structure.F: Macro / Fundamental Data — economy, rates, earnings, filings, estimates
category_structure.G: Event Data — news, catalysts, calendar, transcripts
category_structure.H: Flow / Positioning Data — COT, OI, ETF, options, borrow, liquidations
category_structure.I: Alternative Data — web, satellite, cards, app, shipping, social
category_structure.J: Research / Model Data — signals, scores, backtests, hypotheses
category_structure.K: Compliance / Ops Data — restrictions, audit, settlement, reconciliation
category_structure.L: Data Quality Metadata — freshness, lineage, source, schema, entitlements
